name: ruflo-rure
description: Statically analyze a local JS/Electron app you're authorized to study, with file+line evidence, and build an original reimplementation of what you find. Experimental. Phase 1: JS/Electron static analysis. Phase 2: native ELF/PE/Mach-O container inspection. Phase 3: .NET assembly metadata. Phase 4: EVM bytecode inventory. Phase 5: CUDA fatbin, cubin and PTX inventory. Parses, never executes. Dynamic analysis is a future phase, not yet implemented.
